## 3. Executive Career Chronology (13-Year Cartography)

- **2024 – Present:** Director, Pakistan Sports Board (Punjab)
  - First woman appointed to lead PSB Punjab operations.
  - Direct administrative oversight over 119 athletic sports complexes, 4 national stadiums, and 3,200+ athletes.
  - Spearheading sports economy modernization and grassroots talent incubator.

- **2023 – 2024:** Additional Secretary, Specialized Healthcare & Medical Education
  - Executed PKR 85B procurement restructuring for tertiary hospitals.
  - Implemented real-time pharmaceutical inventory tracking across 24 teaching hospitals.

- **2021 – 2023:** Deputy Commissioner, District Hafizabad
  - Architect of the acclaimed "Hafizabad Model": an integrated 72-hour child protection, emergency medical rescue, and judicial rehabilitation mechanism.
  - Spearheaded district digital governance transformation and public grievance resolution (99.2% resolution rate).

- **2019 – 2021:** Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Gujranwala
  - Digitized 450,000 land record parcels, dismantling predatory syndicates and recovering PKR 12B in state real estate.

- **2017 – 2019:** Assistant Commissioner, City Sub-Division Gujranwala
  - Chief sub-divisional magistrate governing 1.2M municipal citizens.
  - Executed municipal anti-encroachment operations and industrial environmental compliance.

- **2013 – 2017:** Assistant Commissioner, Rawalpindi, Islamabad, and Murree
  - Foundation statecraft, revenue administration, and criminal code enforcement.
